map.对比两个朝代/时期的基本信息,了解历史发展: Compare the basic information of two dynasties/periods to understand historical development
map.📖 查看「era-comparator 使用指南」: 📖 View the User Guide for Dynasty Comparison
map.朝代对比口径：存续年数 = 结束年 − 开始年；同期对照以公元纪年为轴，标出各朝: Dynasty comparison basis: duration = end year − start year; synchronous comparison uses the Gregorian calendar year as axis, marking each dynasty start order and overlap interval; the span can be converted to the ratio of China recorded history length (about 2070 BCE to present, about 4100 years) for horizontal quantitative comparison.
map.备课或写作业时快速核对两个朝代的起止年代与存续时长，例如唐朝 618–907 共: Quickly verify the start/end eras and durations of two dynasties when preparing lessons or homework, e.g. Tang 618–907 (289 years), Ming 1368–1644 (276 years).
map.比较分裂割据时期的并存政权：选「三国(220–280)」与「晋朝(266–420: Compare coexisting regimes in divided periods: select "Three Kingdoms (220–280)" and "Jin (266–420)", the tool computes a 14-year overlap (266–280) of the two regimes.
map.制作时间轴或对比表时，直接取开国君主、都城、疆域、人口等字段，避免逐个翻年表。: When making a timeline or comparison table, take fields like founding monarch, capital, territory and population directly, avoiding flipping through chronologies one by one.
map.存续时长 = 结束年 − 开始年；并存期 = 后一朝代开始年 − 前一朝代结束年: Duration = end year − start year; coexistence period = later dynasty start year − earlier dynasty end year (positive means overlap exists). BCE years are represented as negatives, e.g. Xia dynasty starts at −2070 (i.e. 2070 BCE).
map.唐(618–907，289 年) vs 明(1368–1644，276 年)：无: Tang (618–907, 289 years) vs Ming (1368–1644, 276 years): no time overlap, duration difference 13 years. If Zhou (−1046–−256, 790 years) vs Qin (−221–−206, 15 years): Zhou ends at −256 earlier than Qin starts at −221, no overlap, Zhou is 775 years longer than Qin. If Three Kingdoms (220–280) vs Jin (266–420): overlap 266–280 totals 14 years.
map.朝代起止年为什么常用「约」？: Why are dynasty start/end years often marked "approximate"?
map.早期王朝（夏、商、周）年代多据文献与「夏商周断代工程」推定，存在学术区间；秦以后: Early dynasties (Xia, Shang, Zhou) dates are mostly inferred from documents and the Xia-Shang-Zhou Chronology Project, with academic ranges; after Qin the chronology is more certain, but divided periods (Three Kingdoms, Northern and Southern Dynasties) take regime founding or unification as the boundary, and different general histories may differ.
map.当两个所选朝代的时间轴有交集时显示重叠年数，主要用于分裂割据时期，例如魏蜀吴与西: When the two selected dynasties timelines intersect, the overlap years are shown, mainly for divided periods, e.g. Wei-Shu-Wu and early Western Jin, Northern and Southern Dynasties and surrounding regimes. Unified dynasties generally do not overlap.
map.工具和史书年份为何有出入？: Why do the tool and history books years differ?
map.本工具以单一权威年表为准（含断代工程取值），不同教材或通史可能取整或采用异说，属: This tool follows a single authoritative chronology (including Chronology Project values); different textbooks or general histories may round or adopt alternative accounts, which is a normal difference; when citing, follow the convention of the textbook you use.
